compound_status.name: Nerve Agent
compound_status.scope: Only ABILITY_MR_NERVE_AGENT can inflict this status unless explicitly expanded later.
compound_status.representation: One dedicated major-status value; do not set native Poison and native Paralysis simultaneously.

generic_status_interactions.Hex: Target is statused; apply the normal Hex boost once.
generic_status_interactions.Guts: Counts as having a major status; activate once.
generic_status_interactions.Quick_Feet: Counts as having a major status; activate once.

native_specific_interactions.policy: Do not pretend this is native Poison or native Paralysis for status-specific bonuses/triggers unless explicitly whitelisted.

compound_status.cures: Full Heal/Lum Berry/Heal Bell/Aromatherapy and equivalent generic major-status cures remove the whole compound status.
compound_status.stacking: Cannot stack with itself or consume two native major-status slots.

rationale: Preserves the intended simultaneous poison + paralysis gameplay without corrupting the one-major-status engine model or double-counting generic status interactions.
